uzo.purpose: Shows a known value within a known range, with its number: 66 % conform, 3 of 5 checked.

instead.kialo: Progress of a running task moves by itself and ends, because it is a wait, not a measure; that is an Ero of its own, a person decides.
A state in a word is a badge, because a word has no scale; a meter shows where a number lies.

boundary.kialo: A chart compares many values over an axis, because one bar is one value; charts are no Ero of Fundamento.
Several parts in one bar need a legend, because colour alone names no part (WCAG 1.4.1); one meter shows one value.

containers.name: tabelo
containers.kialo: A meter in a cell shows the value of its row, because the row is what it measures.

containers.name: atributlisto
containers.kialo: A meter as a value shows the measure of the record, because the name beside it says what.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A meter stands where the number it shows is read, because the number is the content.

case.de: Der Zustand ist ein Wort und hat keine Skala.
case.en: The state is a word and has no scale.

case.de: Ein Bereich wartet, bis sein Inhalt geladen ist.
case.en: An area waits until its content has loaded.

case.de: Viele Werte sollen miteinander verglichen werden.
case.en: Many values are to be compared with each other.

do.de: Schreib den Wert auch als Text dazu, etwa „3 von 5 geprüft“.
do.en: Also write the value as text, such as “3 of 5 checked”.

do.de: Gib immer eine Beschriftung an; in einer Tabellenzelle darf sie mit label-hidden unsichtbar sein.
do.en: Always give a label; in a table cell it may be invisible with label-hidden.

do.de: Lass value leer, wenn der Wert unbekannt ist.
do.en: Leave value empty when the value is unknown.

dont.de: Mehrere Teile in einem Balken zeigen, die nur die Farbe unterscheidet.
dont.en: Show several parts in one bar told apart only by colour.

dont.de: Den Fortschritt einer laufenden Aufgabe damit zeigen, denn er bewegt sich von selbst.
dont.en: Show the progress of a running task with it, because that moves by itself.

none.de: Die Anzeige nimmt weder den Fokus noch eine Taste; ein Screenreader liest Name und Wert.
none.en: The meter takes neither the focus nor a key; a screen reader reads its name and value.
